source_notes: On 2026-05-28 TNPA signed a 25-year terminal operator agreement for the Port of Ngqura LNG terminal with Ukwanda LNG, a JV between Tamasa Energy Group and the Strategic Fuel Fund (SFF). The operator is now the Ukwanda LNG JV vehicle, not the SFF alone (GEM previously listed 'Strategic Fuel Fund Association' as operator). SFF remains a JV partner inside Ukwanda LNG. ~R22bn (USD1.34bn) project; TNPA invests ~R2bn in a dedicated LNG berth. New entities Ukwanda LNG + Tamasa Energy Group recorded in entity findings.
scope_note: Single-unit terminal (G100001055097). Operator is a project-level field.

source_notes: Operator agreement (2026-05-28) targets full operationalization by 2035 (was 2029 in GEM). Phasing: a temporary floating (FSRU) unit in early phases, then permanent onshore regasification — consistent with GEM's existing ResearcherNotesUnit. Construction of the dedicated berth est. ~36 months. OriginalPlannedStartYear (2029) left unchanged; only the LATEST planned start is pushed to the 2035 full-ops target. Note FSRU first-gas could precede 2035 full-ops; reviewer may wish to model phases separately.

March 2026: Vopak (via local unit president Oliver Naidu, to Reuters) said the Zululand Energy Terminal FID is now expected in Q1 2028, pushed back from the prior ~2026 plan, after a September 2025 court order halted Eskom's planned 3,000 MW Richards Bay gas-to-power plant (the terminal's key demand driver); pre-FEED extended. FIDStatus stays Pre-FID. Two-phase project ~USD1bn. Preliminary LNG offtake/distribution agreements with Eskom and potentially ExxonMobil expected in coming months. RE-VERIFY NOTE: the Q1-2028 FID datum originates from a single Reuters wire story quoting Vopak; the cited URLs (CBN, Gas Processing News, Global Banking & Finance) are different publishers but all republish that one wire, so this is single-origin corroboration -> confidence downgraded to yellow. All three URLs PASS url_verifier on token '2028'.
scope_note: FIDYear is project-level; in the GEM export it is populated only on Phase 1 (G100002112600). Reviewer to apply project-wide across both unit-rows of T100000131126 per multi-unit field rule.
